Our Story

Named for the fire and the beams

Ember for the roast — the small fire every great cup starts with. Oak for the century-old beams in this old Bank Street storefront, and for the tables our regulars have claimed as their own. We opened in 2019 because the Glebe deserved a coffee house that takes the coffee seriously and everything else easy.

Every cup is made the way we'd make it for a friend: beans roasted in the back room, milk steamed to order, and a pastry case that sells out most afternoons. Get here before three if you want the good stuff.

  • ✓ Beans roasted in-house, never more than 10 days off the roast
  • ✓ Work-friendly: fast Wi-Fi, outlets at every table, no laptop curfew on weekdays
  • ✓ Eggs, dairy and produce from Ottawa-area farms, delivered twice a week
C Claire & Ben Moreau Founders, Ember & Oak
